g.text: Project structure: uv workspace and allowed package dependencies
- hospital_node and supplier_hub never import each other
- equivalence_core imports neither app, no llm_client and no
- llm_client and service_kit import no app and no domain code
- the apps reach the Anthropic SDK only through llm_client
- hospital_node imports no HTTP client (httpx, requests)
tests/e2e is the one place that imports all three:
it starts both apps in-process and drives them
through the demo client, never around it
